extraction.name: PASTIS
extraction.description: PASTIS is an open-access Satellite Image Time Series (SITS) dataset with panoptic annotations for agricultural parcel segmentation. It is presented as the first dataset of its kind for training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models on SITS.
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot; Loic Landrieu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The paper introduces PASTIS as an open-access dataset for training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models on satellite image time series, with panoptic annotations over agricultural parcels.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-temporal satellite imagery / satellite image time series of agricultural parcels, with panoptic annotations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The paper states that PASTIS has panoptic annotations and that ground truth parcels are used to construct target heatmaps for centerpoint detection, but it does not describe the human labeling task, instructions, workforce, or QC process.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper notes that cloud cover can make analysis arduous and that the task requires learning complex temporal, spatial, and spectral patterns specific to agricultural parcels.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset and methods are focused on panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels in satellite image time series; the paper also notes that existing specialized remote sensing methods are limited to semantic segmentation or single-image instance segmentation, implying the task is challenging and specialized. A metric bug affected reported panoptic results, but not training.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work is framed as having economic and environmental stakes, including fair allocation of agricultural subsidies and ensuring crop rotation practices are respected; it also mentions broader applications such as surveying urban development and deforestation.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels from time series of satellite images, supporting semantic segmentation and panoptic segmentation research and evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The paper mentions an open-access dataset and a corrected implementation for evaluation, with a bug fix referenced on GitHub, but does not describe versioning cadence, maintainers, or deprecation policy.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The encoder uses Group Normalization instead of Batch Normalization because the samples are not identically distributed across time; sequences are processed by flattening temporal and batch dimensions.
